mentions.name: Yakki
mentions.description: A Mac dictation app that records meetings and generates insights and notes from them; the developer is expanding its capabilities and tailoring it to specific users who provide feedback.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on https://yakki.ai, a Mac dictation app. I have started expanding what the users can do with it, for the moment you can record your meetings and get insights and notes.
